name: Brine
author: E. T. Carter
description: A brinicle forest: a ceiling of supercold descending brine fingers hangs from the top edge, a field of faceted translucent crystalline columns of varying width and depth, each glinting and breathing frost feathers as a refractive shimmer streams down its interior. Nearer fingers are wide and bright, farther ones slim and dim; a frosted ice band caps them along the top and deep cold water fills between.

params.label: Stream speed
params.effect: Rate of the downward interior shimmer that sinks through each finger, pacing the facet glints.

params.label: Finger width
params.effect: Typical CSS-pixel width of a brine finger, from delicate hanging needles to thick frozen pillars.

params.label: Frost feathers
params.effect: Extent of the frost feathers fanning from each finger's flanks — 0 leaves bare glassy fingers, 2 grows wide lacy crystalline fans that fill between them.

params.label: Crowding
params.effect: How tightly the fingers crowd the frame — low leaves airy gaps of dark water, high packs them into a dense frozen curtain.

params.label: Hang length
params.effect: How far the fingers descend from the ceiling — low leaves short stubs near the top, high streams long icicles toward the bottom of the frame.

params.label: Tip sharpness
params.effect: Sharpness of each finger's point — 0 is a blunt stalactite with a wide rounded tip, 1 a fine icicle needle tapering to nothing.

params.label: Variation
params.effect: Spread of per-finger depth, width, length and position — 0 lines them up as an even rank of identical fingers, 1 gives the full natural scatter of a real brinicle field.

params.label: Top frost pixels
params.effect: Crystalline pixel speckle along the top ice ceiling — 0 removes the frosted band, 1 the default frost, 2 a brighter, denser crust of lit cells.

params.label: Bottom frost pixels
params.effect: A matching pixel-frost band along the bottom edge (a frozen crust on the seabed) — 0 is off, raise it to crust the lower edge to taste.

params.label: Pixel size
params.effect: Cell size of the top and bottom frost pixels in CSS pixels — small is fine sparkle, large is chunky blocky frost.

params.label: Distortion
params.effect: A refractive horizontal wave that travels down the water, warping the fingers, reflections and frost like looking through disturbed glass — 0 is still and clean.
